label: AFFECTION

cover.headline: 4 questions that help you *understand him better*
cover.sub: Curiosity is a kind of closeness.

points.heading: What’s been on your mind?
points.body: An open question invites more than “fine.”
points.panel: “What’s been on your mind this week?”

points.heading: When do you feel most appreciated?
points.body: Everyone feels loved in slightly different ways.
points.panel: “When do you feel most appreciated by me?”

points.heading: What’s stressing you right now?
points.body: Knowing his pressures helps you avoid misreading his mood.

points.heading: What would make this week better?
points.body: Small, practical, and easy to act on.
points.panel: “What’s one thing that would make this week easier for you?”

resource.name: His Secret Obsession
resource.covers: Ideas for understanding attraction and emotional connection.

caption:
It’s easy to assume we know our partner, especially after years together. But people keep changing.

These four questions open the door to understanding him a little better. If you’d like ideas for understanding attraction and emotional connection, there’s a resource at the link in bio. It’s a place to start, and no resource can promise how another person will feel.

Follow @spotseason for more.
